quotes.text: For the password-manager policy browser test in this outgoing stack, the reported source inspection found that Startup() hides the visibility button before asynchronous LoadSignons() sets its disabled state. The test must wait for disabled before asserting it. A separate fixup at revision 2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555 reportedly added that wait. Syntax and diff checks passed, but the focused browser test could not run locally; the evidence does not establish runtime success in that checkout.
